svg.title: From a blob or a message to the consumer job
svg.desc: Uploading or deleting a blob in uploads raises an event that egst-storage delivers to the blob-events queue, or dead-letters to eventgrid-deadletter after 5 retries in 60 minutes. caj-consumer, started by KEDA, peek-locks messages from both queues and completes them, except a message containing fail, which is delivered again until the fifth delivery moves it to the queue's dead-letter subqueue.
